title: Missouri Small Estate Affidavit (2026): $40,000 Net Limit, Real Estate Included
rank_math_description: Missouri small estate affidavit: $40,000 after liens and debts, real estate included, 30-day wait, bond unless waived, and creditor notice above $15,000.
pdf_outline: Worksheet: real + personal property, minus liens, minus debts = test vs $40,000
Bond amount = personal property value; publication needed if listed property > $15,000
Second PDF mo-small-estate-checklist.pdf: 9 steps incl. recording with recorder of deeds

inline_images.alt: Missouri small estate affidavit: affidavit, bond, fee and notice

editor_notes: All rules from RSMo 473.097 text read 26 Sept 2026. Filing fee amount not stated; confirm with the county probate clerk.
